scope: 22 proposed implementation contracts; preserve all chosen equipment, identities, roles, spawn seats and difficulty scales
contractLanguage: declarative trigger/state predicates, not code to eval; all new observations are requirements, not claims about current APIs

unknownMajorTacticPolicy.generator: reject unknown or missing tactic; fail build before runtime
unknownMajorTacticPolicy.runtime: reject invalid roster/tactic capability before actor activation; emit diagnostic and abort test scenario, no silent generic-adaptive fallback
unknownMajorTacticPolicy.missingRequiredObservation: fail capability validation; do not substitute HP ratio, display name, random timing or a generic fallback

sharedRules.lifeScope: worldIdentity + unitIdentity + actorVersion + cycleId; no title authority
sharedRules.visibility: complete windup must be visible; shooter offscreen/target invalid/world changed cancels remaining event queue
sharedRules.interrupt: control/death/retirement/shield phase change cancels unissued events; ammo and identity persist; no delayed refill or replay
sharedRules.counterScope: one counter set per composite action, retained across weapon switches; central budget check before every real primary/secondary/subweapon event
sharedRules.attackInterlock: no simultaneous primary+dual+subweapon; dangerous-action permit covers full composite sequence and releases on terminal paths
sharedRules.movement: use existing collision-aware mover; distance limits are maxima, not teleport destinations; blocked movement ends or cancels the sequence
sharedRules.frameSafety: never accelerate fire events to catch up after low FPS or late cue; discard events that miss their allowed window
sharedRules.dependencyBinding: bind explicit roster identity or authored non-roster spawn ordinal with actor/world identity; never resolve by randomized display name
sharedRules.phaseAndLoot: shield flip does not create another person; boss support retirement is not combat death; no tactic path issues loot directly
sharedRules.AVM1Cost: precompile contract enums and scalar tables; per-actor compact counters; no eval strings, new per-frame arrays, per-shot JSON, or per-tick closure allocation
